name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI that mirrors GitHub repositories, issues, wikis and releases to a self-hosted Gitea or Forgejo instance on a schedule.

alerts.message: The first account to sign up becomes the admin; further sign-ups are disabled. You need a token for the source (for example a GitHub personal access token) and an existing Gitea or Forgejo instance with an access token, both entered on the Configuration page.
